title: Youth commission list of county-funded youth programs
summary: As of the September 21 meeting, the commission is asking for a list of county-funded youth programs. The chair hopes it arrives before the next meeting so it can go out with the meeting packet. A speaker said the problem isn't necessarily a lack of resources but a lack of awareness.
